question: How lethal are guns against humans? The weapon table counts damage in hp with a human at 100. The quest doctrine says humans die to one hit. What should separate the six core weapons: lethality against humans, or range, rate and area (with armoured cops and robots as the sponge)? See the TTK table: still human, strafing human, robot, and enemy fire against a strafing Rivet, at 5/10/20/35 m.

options.label: Doctrine plus sponges: a pistol or nail hits once and the human drops; a machine-pistol human takes 2 hits; armoured cops (250) and robots (600) are where the weapons differ
options.tradeoff: Fast, lethal firefights against humans. Weapon identity shows against armour and robots, and through range and area.

options.label: Tougher humans (200 hp): a pistol takes 2 hits, the machine pistol 4; the rocket and flamer still kill in one go
options.tradeoff: Longer exchanges, so the strafe and dodge matter more. This breaks the quest-1 one-hit doctrine, and combat.json would follow.

options.label: Pure doctrine: every direct hit from every weapon drops a human; only robots and bosses soak
options.tradeoff: Simplest. Against humans, the weapons differ only in hit rate and range.
